question: Which of the following competitions is associated with football?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Santosh Trophy**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Santosh Trophy** is a football competition in India.
 
• It is an annual Indian football tournament which is contested by states and government institutions.
 
• The tournament is named after the late Maharaja Sir M
